## Overview

- Fix folder drag and drop in Desktop so folders open through the same workspace flow as
  **Open folder...**, while preserving Markdown file drops and existing workspace-window reuse.
  Unsupported or unreadable drops now report an error, including on the start screen.
- Report degraded Architecture connector routing during validation and layout inspection,
  before its warning banner appears in rendered or exported output. CLI text reports also
  surface existing layout warnings.
- Preserve rendered table column proportions in PowerPoint exports instead of assigning
  equal widths to every column.
- Disable **Shape editing** on slides without an Architecture diagram, with an accessible
  explanation, and re-enable it when a diagram is available.
- Keep the shared product version aligned at 4.2.6 across the Canvas Extension, Skill, npm CLI,
  and Desktop.

## Compatibility and migration

This patch release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks and the v4
installation model. There are no breaking changes or new runtime requirements. Routing
degradation remains a warning and does not change diagram validity or the clipping verdict.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.2.6`. |
| Desktop folder drops | No action is required; folders now open as workspaces, and Markdown file drops continue to work. |
| Validation and inspection | Text output now includes layout and routing warnings. Prefer `--json` for automation and allow additive diagnostic fields. |
| PowerPoint tables | Re-export decks to preserve the rendered table column proportions in newly generated files. |
